freight.shipHint: Packed weight and outer size of ONE unit. Buyers see a freight estimate from these. Optional.
freight.shipInvalid: Enter the weight as whole grams and the size in cm as positive numbers.
freight.suggestHint: Fills the delivery charge from an estimate. You can change it before sending.
freight.suggestDone: Estimated freight {low} to {high} by {mode}, about {days} days. Filled {mid} (before GST). Change it if your real charge differs.
freight.needPincode: The buyer did not give a delivery pincode, so freight cannot be estimated.
freight.failed: Could not estimate freight right now.
freight.assumedWeight: No packed weight on your listings, so 1 kg per unit was assumed.
